description: Implement the AI-powered adaptive learning engine, AI tutor service, and content generation system. This is the core AI layer that powers personalized learning pathways, vernacular tutoring, and automated content creation using AWS Bedrock/OpenAI integration patterns.
steps: Create packages/ai/src/types.ts - Comprehensive AI types: LearningPath, KnowledgeGraph, CompetencyLevel, LearningObjective, ContentDifficulty, AdaptiveRule, TutorSession, ContentTemplate
Create packages/ai/src/providers/base.ts - Abstract AI provider interface supporting multiple backends (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, custom models) with streaming support
Create packages/ai/src/providers/bedrock.ts - AWS Bedrock provider implementation: model invocation, streaming responses, error handling, retry logic
Create packages/ai/src/providers/openai.ts - OpenAI provider implementation as fallback/alternative with proper API key management

Create packages/ai/src/engine/adaptive-learning.ts - Adaptive learning engine: analyzes student performance, builds knowledge graphs, generates personalized learning paths, adjusts difficulty dynamically based on Bloom's taxonomy levels

Create packages/ai/src/engine/assessment.ts - AI assessment engine: generates questions at appropriate difficulty, evaluates responses (MCQ + subjective), provides detailed feedback, tracks competency progression
Create packages/ai/src/engine/knowledge-graph.ts - Knowledge graph management: creates/updates subject-specific knowledge graphs, maps prerequisites, identifies learning gaps

Create packages/ai/src/tutor/tutor-service.ts - AI Tutor service: manages conversation context, provides explanations in multiple languages (Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, etc.), adapts teaching style to student level, uses Socratic method
Create packages/ai/src/tutor/voice-interface.ts - Voice interface abstraction: speech-to-text/text-to-speech integration points for vernacular AI tutors, language detection

Create packages/ai/src/content/generator.ts - AI content generator: creates lesson plans, quizzes, explanations, summaries from curriculum standards, supports multiple content formats (text, structured, interactive)
Create packages/ai/src/content/curriculum-mapper.ts - Curriculum mapping service: maps content to NEP 2020 competency frameworks, NCERT/state board standards, grade-appropriate difficulty
Create packages/ai/src/teacher-copilot/copilot.ts - Teacher co-pilot: generates lesson plans, suggests activities, creates assessments, provides classroom analytics insights, auto-grades assignments
Create packages/ai/src/teacher-copilot/analytics.ts - Classroom analytics: student engagement scoring, learning pattern detection, at-risk student identification, recommendation generation
Create apps/api/src/handlers/ai/learning-path.ts - Lambda handler for learning path generation and management
Create apps/api/src/handlers/ai/tutor.ts - Lambda handler for AI tutor sessions with WebSocket support pattern
Create apps/api/src/handlers/ai/content.ts - Lambda handler for content generation requests
Create apps/api/src/handlers/ai/assessment.ts - Lambda handler for AI-powered assessment generation and evaluation
Create apps/api/src/handlers/ai/teacher-copilot.ts - Lambda handler for teacher co-pilot features
Create packages/ai/src/__tests__/adaptive-learning.test.ts - Unit tests for adaptive learning engine with mocked AI providers
Create packages/ai/src/__tests__/tutor-service.test.ts - Unit tests for tutor service including multi-language support
Create packages/ai/src/__tests__/content-generator.test.ts - Unit tests for content generation with curriculum mapping
Create packages/ai/src/__tests__/teacher-copilot.test.ts - Unit tests for teacher co-pilot features
acceptance_criteria: All AI package TypeScript files compile without errors
Adaptive learning engine generates valid learning paths given mock student performance data
AI tutor service handles multi-language conversations with proper context management
Content generator produces structured content mapped to curriculum standards
Teacher co-pilot generates lesson plans and assessment items
All unit tests pass with mocked AI provider responses
Provider abstraction allows switching between Bedrock and OpenAI without code changes
Assessment engine generates questions at configurable Bloom's taxonomy levels
